description: The first real AGENT-02 pilot: 1 Main Agent + 2 Sub-Agents, disjoint ownership, C0. Planned only - NOT DISPATCHED. base_sha is regenerated to the then-current origin/main head at dispatch time.

tasks.title: Bring the desktop DBC read-model client validation to domain parity
tasks.objective: The desktop DBC read-model client refuses a malformed Runtime read model at the client boundary instead of admitting it into renderer state: duplicate asset ids, duplicate frame ids inside one database, and a frame whose is_extended disagrees with its frame_id range are rejected with a typed client error. This closes the recorded limitation that client-side validation is contract-shape only (docs/PROJECT_STATE.md §9).
tasks.scope: The DBC read-model client validator and its vitest suite.
non_goals: Re-implementing the Runtime domain validator - the Runtime stays authoritative
Changing the Runtime HTTP contract or any module under runtime/
Adding UI, a new panel, or any new user-visible behaviour
acceptance_criteria: A read model carrying two assets with the same asset id is refused with a typed client error, and no renderer state is produced from it
A read model carrying two frames with the same frame id, or a frame whose is_extended disagrees with its frame_id, is refused the same way
A well-formed read model is still accepted unchanged - the change adds no false rejection
handoff_requirements: Report the exact command and result for pnpm test, pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint at the repository root
Name the new test cases and confirm the pre-existing dbc-client tests still pass
State explicitly that no Runtime file and no Rust file was touched

tasks.title: Read-only inspection of DBC asset files that have no registry row
tasks.objective: A read-only inspection reports every file present under the project DBC asset directory that has no matching dbc_assets registry row - the crash window recorded in docs/PROJECT_STATE.md §9, where the asset file is written and the registry row is not committed. Registry state stays authoritative: the inspection deletes nothing, repairs nothing and writes nothing.
tasks.scope: The DBC project service / registry read path and its unit tests.
non_goals: Automatic cleanup, deletion or repair of any file - an explicit recorded decision
Any SQLite schema or migration change
Any HTTP endpoint, API contract or runtime capability change
acceptance_criteria: An asset file present with no matching registry row is reported as an orphan together with its project-relative path
A registered asset whose file is missing is reported separately as a missing file, never conflated with an orphan
A clean project reports neither, and the inspection mutates nothing: no row inserted, updated or deleted, and no file written or removed
handoff_requirements: Report the exact command and result for the focused pytest run over tests/unit/dbc
Report the exact command and result for ruff and mypy over runtime and tools
State explicitly that no migration was added and that the inspection is read-only
